description: St.School is built on top of Student Tribe — India's largest Gen Z student community, founded in Hyderabad in 2015 to close the gap between tier 2/3 college students and real career opportunity. Backed by T-Hub and Hamzek, and recognized on Forbes' 30 Under 30 Asia list, Student Tribe has spent a decade building the campus network, mentor relationships, and hiring pipeline that St.School students walk straight into.
